text:
maya: quick design review please — new streaming preview for Playground. brief thread of screenshots in comments.

maya: TL;DR: want to tighten streaming UX so interruptions feel less jarring, improve token visibility, and add an easier prompt-shelf insert flow.

theo: looked through — love the shimmer-to-text transition. one concern: when a user hits Stop we show partial content + a regen CTA. do we mean Cancel or Pause?

maya: good call. current proposal: `Stop` = stop generation but keep what streamed, `Regenerate` = restart from same prompt. adding a separate `Interrupt` (keyboard shortcut) would just pause the stream and keep model context.

ben: tagging perf: if Stop preserves the KV cache we can do quick regen w/o cold-start. is that feasible on dedicated pools?

sam: yes, we can snapshot KV for N seconds. but need a debounce to avoid accidental double-regens. proposing 500ms guard.

carla: accessibility nit: visible label is "Stop" but VoiceOver reads it as "Stop generation" — we should set `aria-label="Stop generation, keep partial output"` to be explicit. also ensure the regen button has clear `aria-disabled` state while cooling down.

maya: nice, add that to the copy doc. also copy tweak: instead of "Tokens used" we say "Session tokens" and show a tooltip: "Approximate compute tokens billed for this chat". thoughts?

theo: prefer "Token burn"? feels more immediate but maybe too slangy for enterprise. "Session tokens" is safer.

ben: UI question — where to put the counter? current mock shows it in the bottom-right of the chat pane. what about integrating it into the send bar (left of send) so it moves with focus?

maya: prototype A has counter in send bar, prototype B has persistent small badge in header. We should test both for discoverability. A wins for single-turn flows, B for long-lived threads.

carla: keyboard: add `Esc` to stop streaming and `Ctrl+R` to regenerate. make sure `Esc` mapping doesn't conflict with screen reader escape patterns.

sam: noted. on the backend we'll expose a `stop` RPC and `regen` RPC. regen will check cached KV snapshot; if snapshot expired, show a toast: "fast regen unavailable — warming up model".

maya: prompt library change: add an inline + badge to quick-insert suggested prompts (hover reveals metadata: tokens/last-used). click-to-insert should paste into prompt composer without stealing focus.

theo: micro-interaction: when you insert a prompt, animate a 150ms highlight so the user sees content was injected. keep focus in composer so they can edit immediately.

carla: a11y: ensure the insert action is reachable by keyboard (tab) and has `aria-live="polite"` announcement: "Prompt inserted: <title>".

ben: dev question: prompt insert API needs to support `preserveCursor` flag. otherwise caret jumps to end. add to spec.

maya: mock snippets posted here: https://url/screenshot1 (stream shimmer -> final), https://url/screenshot2 (stop/regenerate layout), https://url/screenshot3 (prompt shelf).

theo: my only UX ask — reduce visual weight of regen button. currently it's as bold as primary CTA which makes it too tempting. make it tertiary + outline.

maya: agree. make regen tertiary and add a confirm for 2nd regen within 3s (prevent accidental double-click).

carla: copy suggestion for toast when stop is hit: "Generation stopped — partial result saved. Regenerate to retry." keeps it explicit for screen reader users.

sam: infra note: if user hits regen many times we'll add a client-side rate limit + server-side quota enforcement. show the remaining cooldown as a small countdown next to the regen button.

ben: token counter: show live increment (0.2s throttle). clicking the counter expands a small panel with per-turn breakdown and an export CSV action.

maya: design followups: 1) dark mode mocks 2) keyboard flow doc 3) prompt library taxonomy (tagging). I'll attach updated Figma later.

devex-bot: Reminder — design review meeting scheduled: 1895000300 (UTC). Add to calendar? (react with :thumbsup: to confirm)

maya: thanks all. very actionable. labels: owner=maya, followups=@theo (micro-interaction), @sam (KV snapshot/debounce), @carla (a11y copy), @ben (API flag + token panel).

theo: quick UX tweak on wording: "Regenerate" -> "Try again" for less intimidating language. small win.

carla: +1 to "Try again". better for localization.

maya: noted — will update copy doc and push new mocks before the meeting. :rocket:

sam: merging async notes into ticket #PL-4821.

ben: LGTM.

maya: closing the loop — will post final mocks and test plan here once done. thanks!
